I had a terrible car accident and suffered severe consequences with Physical, Mental and Emotional Distress. Prior to this accident I’ve been fit \u0026 well and very rarely was seen by a doctor previously. I’m a Amateur Long Distance Marathon Runner  and ran The London Marathon Twice in two consecutive years of 2023 \u0026 2024  and was selected for 2025 as I qualified GFA entry and ran for Cancer Research Charity but unfortunately could not participate due to my accident, physical injuries aswell as suffering from severe PTSD. I was terminated from my long serving job and my life has taken a drastic turn. Dr Samantha Line has given me a new perspective of Life. Words will not be enough to say how special she is. She is an Angel for me and surely for many others like me whose lives have been impacted in ways which cannot be explained or described. I’m under her care for past 11 months and each time I go for my consultation she welcomes me with a Beautiful Smile and tells me everything will be fine and that really assures me that life is still worth living and there are great beautiful people around in this world. I sincerely appreciate your kindness, help, support Dr Samantha Line along with all your other doctors and receptionists.
